situation.label: Situation
situation.text: A business wallet sent USDC to a phishing contract. Within hours, funds moved through two intermediary wallets and deposited to a major exchange.

action.label: What Lenix did
action.text: We mapped the full transaction path, labeled the deposit address, and prepared an evidence packet with transaction graphs and timeline notes for the exchange compliance team.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.text: The exchange compliance desk accepted the filing. Funds were frozen pending review. Counsel received the same documentation for parallel legal steps.

CaseStudy.disclaimer: Results vary by case, jurisdiction, and exchange response time. This example shows how Lenix documents a trail—not every case ends in recovery.
